name: UX3 Product Design Harness
tagline: Give your AI agent a product judgment layer before the next build.
description: For product leaders, founders, designers and engineering teams deciding what to build next. Review a feature, workflow, experiment, launch or feedback signal across User Flow, Evidence Flow and Business Flow. Produce a continue, verify or stop_reframe verdict with the weakest lane, evidence gaps and an explicit execution boundary. Use Quick Gate for a small reversible decision, Standard Gate for a feature or workflow, or UX3 Council for deeper review. The complete MIT-licensed skill includes schemas, decision rules, templates, Python validators, worked examples and diagrams. Validators check structure and internal consistency; they do not prove supplied evidence is true or replace accountable human judgment. Uses the team's existing agent and model permissions. Optional external evidence retrieval requires user/host authorization; no fixed publisher service or API key is configured by this skill. To discuss adoption in your team's product workflow, connect with the author: https://www.linkedin.com/in/cis2042/.

install.notes: Free open-source skill. Keep the complete skill folder, including resources and LICENSE. Local validators require Python 3 and jsonschema; the user's chosen agent/model may have separate inference costs. No MCP server or hosted UX3 service is required.
